svg.text: 1. NOT YET CHECKED: VERIFY PARTS, PINOUTS AND LENGTHS AGAINST THE DATASHEETS AND DESIGN BEFORE RELEASE.
2. FABRICATE, INSPECT AND TEST PER IPC/WHMA-A-620, CLASS 2.
3. ALL DIMENSIONS IN MM. LENGTHS ARE MEASURED FROM CONNECTOR REAR FACE TO BREAKOUT CENTRE OR TO THE NEXT CONNECTOR REAR FACE.
4. LENGTH TOLERANCES UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: over: ±3. SEGMENT DIMENSIONS GOVERN; OVERALL DIMENSIONS ARE REFERENCE.
5. DRAWING NOT TO SCALE. WIRE CUT LENGTHS PER WIRE LIST; CONNECTIONS PER CONNECTOR TABLES AND WIRING DIAGRAM.
6. THE 3D ROUTE IS SHOWN FLATTENED, AS LAID ON THE FORMBOARD; SEE THE 3D VIEW FOR ITS SHAPE IN PLACE.
7. CONTINUITY-TEST 100% AGAINST THE WIRE LIST; NO SHORTS BETWEEN NETS.
8. DERIVED FROM LULZBOT DRAWING EL-HR0091 REV A (ALEPH OBJECTS, INC., CC BY-SA 4.0).
9. BARE SHIELD WIRE OF EACH CABLE TO P1 PINS 5, 10 AND 15; TRIM THE SHIELD AT THE MOTOR END.
10. BRAIDED SLEEVING OVER EACH CABLE, ENDING 10 MM SHORT OF EACH CABLE END.
